name: What is the typical timeline for custom spa construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for custom spa construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for custom spa construction varies depending on design complexity, material selections, and site conditions. Generally, the process from initial design to completion can take anywhere from 8 to 16 weeks. This includes detailed planning, permitting, excavation, plumbing and electrical installation, shell construction, finishing, and final testing. Factors such as unique features or unforeseen site challenges can extend this duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom spa construction typically takes 8 to 16 weeks from design to completion, depending on complexity and site conditions.
